 From brilliant creatives, to technology trailblazers, across the globe, WBD offers career defining opportunities, thoughtfully curated benefits, and the tools to explore and grow into your best selves. Here you are supported, here you are celebrated, here you can thrive.
 








 Your New Role: The Senior Principal, System Architecture reports to the VP Engineering, Converged AdTech \& Linear Systems and leads the architecture for WBD’s most critical advertising technology platforms. This role owns and drives the systems automation architecture of core adtech platforms to improve scalability, reliability, performance, and cost efficiency across the ecosystem. This role is accountable for the architecture, scalability, and operational excellence of systems spanning converged planning, linear and digital advertising, scheduling, and affiliate distribution. By architecting the platform rationalization, cloud migration, and next\-generation AI/ML\-enabled capabilities, the Principal ensures WBD’s ad\-tech stack is positioned to maximize monetization, enable automation, and deliver premium advertising experiences across all platforms.
 







 Your Role Accountabilities:
 



 AI‑Driven \& Agentic Systems Automation
 



 Define and drive the long\-term architecture for AI\-powered and agentic systems across large\-scale AdTech platforms. • Architect autonomous and human\-in\-the\-loop systems for deployment orchestration, infrastructure lifecycle, and incident response • Establish guardrails for safe, observable, and governed AI adoption (reliability, explainability, failure handling) • Integrate AI capabilities into core platform layers (decisioning, optimization, experimentation, operations) • Drive standardization of agentic workflows across engineering and operations Expectation: redefines how systems are built and operated using AI and not just adds features.
 







 Platform Architecture \& System Engineering
 



 Own the design and evolution of foundational platforms with strong system engineering principles. • Define architecture for core platforms (AdOps automation, optimization, identity, data, measurement, activation) with clear boundaries and contracts • Apply system engineering rigor across reliability, scalability, fault isolation, and performance under extreme load • Establish patterns for multi\-region, high\-availability, and disaster\-resilient systems • Drive platform standardization to reduce fragmentation and improve developer velocity Expectation: builds platforms that are resilient, composable, and operable at scale.
 







 Enterprise System Evolution \& Convergence Lead transformation of fragmented systems into a cohesive, converged AdTech ecosystem (linear \+ digital).
 



 • Identify systemic bottlenecks across latency, data consistency, and cross platform dependencies
 



 • Drive simplification of system topology and elimination of redundant architectures
 



 • Lead large\-scale modernization (monolith → services, siloed systems → shared platforms)
 



 • Ensure seamless interoperability across legacy and next\-gen systems Expectation: reduces long\-term complexity while enabling scale and agility. Technology Strategy \& Architectural Leadership Shape the long\-term technology direction and elevate architectural capability across the organization.
 



 • Evaluate emerging technologies (streaming, distributed systems, AI infra, Agentic AI, privacy tech) for strategic adoption • Mentor Principal engineers and architects on system design and trade offs • Establish architectural governance and decision frameworks Expectation: builds both systems and the people who design them.
 



 Technical Authority \& Execution Influence
 



 Act as the highest\-level technical authority across critical initiatives. • Review and approve architecture for high\-impact, high\-risk systems • Influence execution across orgs without direct authority • Intervene in complex programs to de\-risk delivery and ensure architectural integrity • Align engineering, product, and business stakeholders on critical trade offs Expectation: drives decisions that materially impact system and business outcomes
 



 Qualifications \& Experience
 



 • Systems Architecture Leadership: 15\+ years of experience architecting and scaling enterprise\-grade data platforms, with a proven track record in large scale ingestion, transformation, and activation pipelines.
 



 • Automation Expertise: Experience automating high‑availability, high‑throughput production environments, leveraging AI and agentic architectures.
 



 • Distributed Data Expertise: Advanced knowledge of open data Lakehouse formats (Iceberg, Delta, Hudi), distributed compute frameworks (Spark, Flink, Presto), and streaming technologies (Kafka, Kinesis, Pub/Sub).
 



 • Cloud \& Modern Architecture: Hands\-on expertise in cloud\-native data design (AWS, GCP, Azure), microservices, APIs, and serverless architectures; demonstrated success in modernizing legacy platforms into modular, cost efficient systems.
 



 • Identity \& Audience Platforms: Familiarity with identity resolution, audience graphs, and cross\-platform measurement systems in media, advertising, or adjacent high\-scale transaction domains.
 



 • Engineering Excellence: Deep knowledge of data engineering best practices, CI/CD automation, observability, data lineage, and governance frameworks that ensure reliability and compliance.
 



 • Performance \& Optimization: Skilled in cost modeling, benchmarking, and optimizing large\-scale distributed systems for throughput, latency, and cost efficiency.
 



 • Industry Awareness: Strong grasp of emerging trends in ad\-tech, programmatic ecosystems, ML/AI\-driven data products, and privacy\-first architectures (GDPR, CCPA, VPPA).
 



 • Partnerships \& Ecosystem: Experienced in leading technical evaluations, vendor integrations, and collaborations with third\-party data providers, cloud platforms, and open\-source communities.
 



 • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical discipline required
 















  


**How We Get Things Done…**









 This last bit is probably the most important! Here at WBD, our guiding principles are the core values by which we operate and are central to how we get things done. You can find them at
 

















 www.wbd.com/guiding\-principles/
 

















 along with some insights from the team on what they mean and how they show up in their day to day. We hope they resonate with you and look forward to discussing them during your interview.
 








**Championing Inclusion at WBD**



 Warner Bros. Discovery embraces the opportunity to build a workforce that reflects a wide array of perspectives, backgrounds and experiences. Being an equal opportunity employer means that we take seriously our responsibility to consider qualified candidates on the basis of merit, regardless of sex, gender identity, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, religion or belief, marital status, pregnancy, parenthood, disability or any other category protected by law.
 









 If you’re a qualified candidate with a disability and you require adjustments or accommodations during the job application and/or recruitment process, please visit our
 
 accessibility page
 
 for instructions to submit your request.

**Company overview:**
 TraceLink is the world’s largest Agentic Business Network, enabling life sciences and healthcare companies to build and manage a scalable digital workforce of governed, no\-code AI agents that execute and coordinate mission\-critical supply chain operations alongside human teams. Powered by the Integrate\-Once™ OPUS platform, TraceLink links more than 300,000 network participants, enabling multi\-enterprise processes at global scale.
   

  

 Founded in 2009 with the simple mission of protecting patients, today Tracelink has 5 global offices, over 800 employees and more than 1700 customers in over 60 countries around the world. Our expanding product suite continues to protect patients and now also enhances multi\-enterprise collaboration through innovative new applications such as MINT.
   

  

 Tracelink is recognized as an industry leader by Gartner and IDC, and for having a great company culture by Comparably.
   

  

**Role Summary**

title: Network Architect
description:

**Position Summary**
 Candescent is seeking an experienced and innovative
 **Network Architect**

This role is responsible for developing scalable, secure, and resilient network architectures that support corporate offices, cloud environments, financial institution operations, and emerging business initiatives.
   

  

 The Network Architect will partner closely with Infrastructure, Security, Cloud Engineering, Application Development, and Operations teams to define technology roadmaps, establish engineering standards, and drive modernization initiatives. **Key Responsibilities**
**Enterprise Network Architecture**
* Develop and maintain the enterprise network architecture roadmap.
* Design highly available, scalable, and secure LAN, WAN, WLAN, SD\-WAN, Cloud and B2B Networking and internet edge solutions.
* Create and maintain high\-level and low\-level network designs, standards, and reference architectures.
* Evaluate existing environments and recommend improvements aligned with business objectives.
* Establish networking standards and governance for all Candescent locations and hosted environments.


**Cloud \& Hybrid Networking**
* Design connectivity solutions for Azure, AWS,GCP (Must Have) and hybrid cloud deployments.
* Define architectures for cloud transit networking, DNS, routing, security segmentation, and application delivery.
* Lead cloud networking initiatives on secure multi\-cloud connectivity.
* Collaborate with cloud engineering teams on network automation and infrastructure\-as\-code initiatives.


**Security Architecture \& Compliance**

* Develop architectures supporting Zero Trust, network segmentation, NAC, SASE, ZTNA, and secure remote access.

**Strategic Leadership**
* Provide architectural oversight for major infrastructure projects.
* Lead technology evaluations, proof\-of\-concepts, and vendor assessments.
* Develop multi\-year network technology roadmaps and lifecycle management strategies.
* Influence infrastructure direction through innovation and industry best practices.
* Present architectural recommendations to senior leadership and executive stakeholders.


**Operational Excellence**
* Act as the highest escalation point for complex networking issues.
* Review network performance, capacity, resiliency, and availability metrics.
* Guide disaster recovery and business continuity planning efforts.
* Ensure infrastructure designs align with operational supportability requirements.


**Automation \& Modernization**
* Promote network automation and orchestration strategies.
* Design solutions utilizing APIs, scripting, and infrastructure\-as\-code platforms.
* Drive adoption of modern operational models and observability platforms.
* Partner with engineering teams to implement automated provisioning and configuration management.


**Mentorship \& Collaboration**
* Mentor Network Engineers and Senior Engineers on architecture and design principles.
* Participate in technical reviews, change advisory boards, and project governance.
* Foster technical excellence across Infrastructure Engineering teams.
* Build strong partnerships with business units, application owners, vendors, and managed service providers.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related discipline.
* 10\+ years of enterprise networking experience.
* 5\+ years designing large\-scale, mission\-critical network environments.
* Expert level experience with:
+ GCP Networking
+ Cloud and B2B Networking
+ Palo Alto Networks firewalls
+ Meraki Wireless networking technologies
+ SD\-WAN solutions

* Strong experience designing:
+ Fortigate Network firewalls
+ Corporate office networks
+ Hybrid cloud connectivity
+ Individual Financial Institution Networks

* Experience with network security architecture and segmentation strategies.
* Proven ability to lead large\-scale infrastructure transformation projects.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Financial services or regulated industry experience.
* Experience with:
+ Cisco Wireless / Meraki
+ Palo Alto Networks \& SCM
+ Azure networking
+ AWS networking
+ GCP networking (Must Have)
+ Prisma Access
+ Network automation platforms

* Knowledge of infrastructure\-as\-code frameworks.
* Experience with monitoring and observability platforms.
* Strong written documentation and presentation skills.


**Certifications (Nice To Have)**
* Palo Alto Networks Certified Network Security Architect (PCNSA/PCNSE)
* Professional Cloud Network Engineer (PCNE)
* AWS Advanced Networking Specialty
* Microsoft Azure Network Engineer Associate
* Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)


**Success Metrics**
**The Successful Network Architect Will**
* Establish enterprise architecture standards and governance.
* Improve network reliability, resiliency, and security posture.
* Reduce operational complexity through standardization and automation.
* Lead infrastructure modernization initiatives.
* Support business growth through scalable network design.
* Serve as the trusted technical advisor for network strategy across Candescent.

Please do not forward resumes to our applicant tracking system, Candescent employees, or any Candescent facility.  9\-11 years of experience in software development or technology infrastructure engineering required; experience in the securities or financial services industry is a plus.
